subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 表达喜好：I like... 我喜欢……；I don't like... 我不喜欢……。Would you like...? 你想要/想吃……吗？— Yes, please. / No, thanks. I'd like some... 我想要一些……（I'd like = I would like）。
formulas: 示例：What do you like? I like apples. / I'd like some milk.
cautions: ①Would you like 后接 some 而非 any；②like 后接动词用 -ing（I like swimming）或 to do，勿接原形；③I don't like 误写成 I doesn't like（I 后用 don't）；④would like 与 like 用法混淆。
